name: osaka-trip-2026
description: 大阪旅遊規劃應用程式 2026

scripts.build: pkg . --out-dir dist && mkdir -p dist/data && cp public/data/plan.json public/data/reminders.json public/data/locpins.json dist/data/
scripts.build:arm64: pkg . --out-dir dist --target node20-macos-arm64 && mkdir -p dist/data && cp public/data/plan.json public/data/reminders.json public/data/locpins.json dist/data/
scripts.build:x64: pkg . --out-dir dist --target node20-macos-x64   && mkdir -p dist/data && cp public/data/plan.json public/data/reminders.json public/data/locpins.json dist/data/
